description: S458 slice 2 (position 1): a LITERAL reassigned into a refined cell is decided at compile time. `@link = "javascript:alert(1)"` into `<link>: string(url)` is E-CONTRACT-001 — the same static zone a declaration's literal initializer gets.
rationale: §53.4.2 rule 2: a string literal against a named shape is statically decided; §53.11: "The compiler SHALL emit E-CONTRACT-001 when a literal value is assigned to a constrained type variable and the literal demonstrably fails the predicate."
